hero.description: We are an authorized tourism agency based in Cusco, Peru. With a team of passionate professionals, our goal is for you to experience Peru in an authentic and unforgettable way.

quienes_somos.description_1: We are an authorized tourism agency based in Cusco, Peru, with a team of tourism professionals, our main objective is to fully satisfy visitors who decide to discover this region of the world.
quienes_somos.description_2: We operate mainly in the Cusco area, where we offer a wide variety of tours: from conventional tours to expeditions to the Peruvian Amazon jungle and the Salkantay Trek. We offer a visit to the Machu Picchu sanctuary and a tour of the city of Cusco, where you can delight in the wonderful festivals, cultures and natural landscapes of this region.

equipo.description: Committed to your perfect experience. Each advisor is verified and available on WhatsApp.

ventajas.description: Commitment, quality and experience in every adventure we undertake together.

items.descripcion: Expert native guides who know every corner and secret of our Andean land.
We tailor each experience to specific travel needs and preferences.
Specialized team with international certifications and more than 10 years of experience.
Complete support before, during and after your trip via WhatsApp.
Registered with MINCETUR and DIRCETUR. Your safety and peace of mind is our priority.
Attention and guides in Spanish, English and Portuguese for travelers from all over the world.

historia.description: From our beginnings in Cusco to becoming one of the most reliable agencies in the country.

hitos.titulo: We are born from the passion for Peru
hitos.descripcion: PerúTravel was born from the passion to share the wonders of Peru with travelers from all over the world. We begin in Cusco, taking the first visitors to discover the magic of the Inca city.
We expanded our services to destinations such as the Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, the Amazon jungle and the famous Inca Trail, bringing experiences and travelers from more countries.

We obtained certifications from CALTUR, DIRCETUR, MINCETUR and membership in ATTA (Adventure Travel Trade Association), consolidating ourselves as a trusted tour operator on the national and international scene.

hitos.titulo: Today we are a reference in Cusco
hitos.descripcion: Today we are one of the most trusted agencies in Cusco, with thousands of satisfied travelers from all over the world committed to the excellence, sustainability and authenticity of tourism in Peru.

mision_vision.description: The principles that guide every tour, every decision and every experience we create.

mision.descripcion: Provide exceptional tourist experiences that connect travelers with the rich history, culture and nature of Peru, exceeding their expectations at every moment of the trip.

vision.descripcion: To be the leading tourism agency in Cusco and Peru, internationally recognized for our quality of service, social commitment and sustainable and responsible tourism practices.

certificaciones.description: Endorsed by the main tourism institutions of Peru and international organizations.
